references.text: The tribe of Asher is also mentioned in the census of Israel, where the leader of the tribe is presented.
Asher was one of Jacob's sons, and his birth is described here. Setur represents the tribe of Asher as a spy.
The list of all twelve spies sent out to explore the land of Canaan, where Setur is one of them.
Jacob's blessing over Asher, the patriarch of the tribe that Setur belonged to.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Asher, which Setur represented among the spies.
